title: Frosted quote card over a pulled-back photo
summary: A blurred glass card shrinks into place while a warm lifestyle photo pulls back behind it, then a customer quote writes in word by word, the attribution fades up and a heart lights. One calm, readable proof shot.
use_when: A single customer quote as the social-proof beat of a launch film
Silent feed posts where one testimonial must read in under 3 s
You have a warm lifestyle or customer photo and no product UI to show
Looping card for a site hero or testimonial carousel slot

look.type_style: neutral grotesk, regular weight, sentence case, white quote 3 lines at ~3.4 % H; attribution 2 lines in muted grey at the same size; small corner wordmark and URL

structure.shot: warm photo of a person at a laptop, tight crop; an empty heavily frosted rounded card covers the centre-left; corner wordmark and URL
structure.camera: pull-out on the photo, scale ~1.25 -> 1.00 by 1.00 s (motion.json -24 %/s in second 0), easings.outQuint
structure.motion: card scales down ~60 % -> 38 % of frame width and drifts right/down, springs.layout ~23 fr (overshoot not measurable); backdrop blur stays heavy

structure.shot: the card holds a customer quote, 3 lines, about 14 words, praising time saved, opened by a quote mark
structure.camera: pull-out settles at 1.00 s, then static
structure.motion: quote words write in left to right, line by line, blur-in per word, gap ~1.5 fr, easings.outExpo 12 fr (±0.25 s); all 3 lines set by 1.50 s (f45)

structure.shot: attribution row appears under the quote: round avatar, name and role in 2 grey lines, a heart icon at the right edge (dim)
structure.motion: avatar fades in at 1.50 s, name and role blur-in 1.77 -> 2.00 s, easings.outExpo 12 fr (±0.25 s); card narrows ~36 % -> 32 % of width, springs.ui (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: finished testimonial card holds over the photo; heart icon now solid white
structure.motion: card grows back to ~40 % of width with the heart lighting at 2.50 s, springs.pop (overshoot not measurable); then hold 79 fr

params.photo: one warm lifestyle or customer photo, landscape, subject right of centre
params.author: name of the person quoted
params.role: role and company of the person quoted
params.avatar: optional square avatar image; initials if absent
params.url: site URL for the top-right corner

notes: Single shot, 0 cuts, silent. Card is a frosted glass panel (backdrop blur over the photo): proposed term frosted-card, not in vocabulary. Card size dips to ~32 % then returns to ~40 % of width around 2.27-2.50 s; sheet resolution 0.25 s. Quote text reads as ~3.4 % of frame height on the card. sfx planned by the glue rule, not measured. Theme: footage mid luminance (L ~0.45), nearest rule light; quote text is white on a translucent card.
